text:
maya: quick one VoiceOver flagged extra tab stops when the playground run history is collapsed. Two options i see: make each call label tabbable or add a skiplink like 'Jump to latest' + aria-live. which feels better? jesse: skiplink + aria-live from me. avoids keyboard noise. make the link visible on focus so people can find it. :thumbsup: samir: +1. implementation notes: programmatic focus target (tabindex='-1' on the anchor target), role="region" and aria-live="polite" on the run container, and a short sr-only summary for collapsed stacks. small snippet: ` Jump to latest
Latest invocation: TranslateText success
` ellen: copy nit: use "Jump to latest" (short) and change tool action label from "Run" to "Run tool" so context is clearer in the structured-output panel. also add a tooltip for the shortcut. maya: agree. small PR with storybook demo? tag a11y. want to test with VoiceOver on mac. a11y-bot: scheduled a quick accessibility check: 2024-04-03 10:00 PT. invites sent to maya, samir, ellen, jesse. reminder 30m prior. jesse: i'll put up the prototype (skiplink styles + aria-live) and include a checklist: visible focus, no duplicate link text, condensed sr-only summaries for collapsed items. samir: also ensure collapsed visual items are aria-hidden but include sr-only text summarizing count + last tool name to avoid additional tab stops. maya: perfect. drop the PR link here when ready and i'll run the flows. thanks! :rocket:
